visual.meaning: Modern DBs mein JSON column store karna, NoSQL jaisi flexibility aur SQL ki safety dono ek hi column mein.

beats.cap: Pehle users table banate hain, phir do rows insert karte hain, meta JSON mein skill array add karte hain, aur Hindi users filter karte hain, full on demo!
beats.say: Pehle users table banate hain, phir do rows insert karte hain, meta JSON mein skill array add karte hain, aur Hindi users filter karte hain, full on demo!
beats.title: **Demo**

steps.sql: UPDATE users SET meta = JSON_SET(meta,'$.skills','["SQL","Python"]') WHERE id=1;

beats.cap: Toh batao, meta->>'city' query karne par kitni rows aayengi? Zyadatar log bolenge 2 rows, Galat! Actually 2 rows aayengi kyunki sirf Hindi users hain.
